project_name: AWS New Carlisle Data Center Campus
status_detail: South Bend Regional Chamber says AWS launched an $11B data center campus on 1,200 acres in New Carlisle and that it is already powering Anthropic model training, with construction milestones in fall 2025; state/Amazon announcements described a 10-year build and at least 1,000 jobs.
notes: Capacity estimate from GovTech/Times reporting of 2,250 MW; chamber page confirms $11B, New Carlisle, 1,200 acres and operational/training use while broader campus remains under buildout.

aliases: Microsoft St. Joe Farm data center

notes: Capacity from Cleanview tracker; news and Microsoft local materials support site/acquisition/planning but final site plan and permits were unresolved in March-May 2026.

project_name: New Carlisle $13B data center rezoning proposal
status_detail: St. Joseph County Council voted 7-2 on Dec. 10, 2025 to deny rezoning for a $13B data center proposal targeting about 1,000 acres of farmland off Chicago Trail near New Carlisle.
notes: Developer name not confirmed from public news in this pass; Baxtel labels the cancelled proposal as Western Hospitality with a 1,057-acre lot, but that is tracker evidence.

project_name: Abei Energy Starke County data center proposal

status_detail: WKVI reported Abei Energy contacted the Starke County Planning Commission about a data center project and rezoning two parcels from Agricultural to Industrial; county then moved toward and approved a 12-month hyperscale data center moratorium.
notes: No site acreage or capacity found. Moratorium does not by itself reject the named proposal permanently, so status is kept as planned/blocked by moratorium rather than rejected.

project_name: Vanderburgh County data center application deferral / research committee
status_detail: 14 News reported on Aug. 5, 2026 that Vanderburgh County leaders were working to establish a data center research committee and temporarily defer all data center applications while studying land, utilities, water, and related impacts.
notes: This is not a named project; included as a county-level development-control signal. News says applications would be deferred while committee work proceeds.
